SELECT
    "DisplayName",
    CASE
        WHEN "Reputation" < 1000 THEN 'Beginner'
        WHEN "Reputation" < 5000 THEN 'Intermediate'
        ELSE 'Advanced'
    END AS "ExpertiseTier"
FROM "users";

SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    CASE 
        WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 THEN 'Beginner'
        WHEN u.Reputation >= 1000 AND u.Reputation < 10000 THEN 'Intermediate'
        ELSE 'Advanced'
    END AS ExpertiseTier
FROM users u

SELECT u.DisplayName,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Gold%' THEN 3
                WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Silver%' THEN 2
                WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Bronze%' THEN 1
                ELSE 0 END) AS prestige_score
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Gold%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Gold%' THEN 3 WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Silver%' THEN 2 WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Bronze%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prestige_score FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.Name LIKE '%Gold%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

SELECT u."DisplayName" AS display_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lower(b."Name") LIKE '%gold%' THEN 3
                WHEN lower(b."Name") LIKE '%silver%' THEN 2
                WHEN lower(b."Name") LIKE '%bronze%' THEN 1
                ELSE 0 END) AS prestige_score
FROM "users" u
JOIN "badges" b ON u."Id" = b."UserId"
GROUP BY u."Id", u."DisplayName"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN lower(b."Name") LIKE '%gold%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1;

WITH user_tiers AS (
    SELECT 
        Id,
        Reputation,
        CASE 
            WHEN Reputation < 1000 THEN 'Novice'
            WHEN Reputation <= 5000 THEN 'Experienced'
            ELSE 'Expert'
        END AS tier
    FROM users
    WHERE Reputation IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.Id) AS badge_count,
    AVG(u.Reputation) AS avg_reputation
FROM user_tiers u
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY tier;

WITH post_tags AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id,
        p.Title,
        COALESCE(p.Score, 0) AS Score,
        COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) AS ViewCount,
        t.TagName,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN 1
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 39 THEN 2
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END AS StarRating,
        (CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN 1
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 39 THEN 2
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3
            WHEN COALESCE(p.Score, 0) BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END) * COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) AS WeightedStarRating
    FROM posts p
    JOIN tags t
      ON p.Tags LIKE '%' || '<' || t.TagName || '>' || '%'
    WHERE p.ViewCount IS NOT NULL AND p.ViewCount > 0
),
avg_per_tag AS (
    SELECT
        TagName,
        ROUND(SUM(StarRating * ViewCount) * 1.0 / SUM(ViewCount), 2) AS WeightedAvgStarRating
    FROM post_tags
    GROUP BY TagName
),
top_posts AS (
    SELECT
        TagName,
        Id,
        Title,
        WeightedStarRating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TagName ORDER BY WeightedStarRating DESC) AS rn
    FROM post_tags
)
SELECT
    a.TagName,
    a.WeightedAvgStarRating,
    json_group_array(
        json_object(
            'Id', tp.Id,
            'Title', tp.Title,
            'WeightedStarRating', tp.WeightedStarRating
        )
    ) AS TopPosts
FROM avg_per_tag a
JOIN top_posts tp ON tp.TagName = a.TagName
WHERE tp.rn <= 3
GROUP BY a.TagName, a.WeightedAvgStarRating
ORDER BY a.WeightedAvgStarRating DESC;

WITH post_stars AS (
    SELECT 
        p.Id,
        p.Title,
        p.Tags,
        p.Score,
        COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) AS ViewCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN p.Score IS NULL OR p.Score < 20 THEN 1
            WHEN p.Score < 40 THEN 2
            WHEN p.Score < 60 THEN 3
            WHEN p.Score < 80 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END AS StarRating
    FROM posts p
),
tagged_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TagName,
        ps.Id AS PostId,
        ps.Title,
        ps.ViewCount,
        ps.StarRating,
        CAST(ps.StarRating AS REAL) * ps.ViewCount AS WeightedStarRating
    FROM post_stars ps
    CROSS JOIN tags t
    WHERE ps.ViewCount > 0 
      AND ps.Tags IS NOT NULL
      AND INSTR('<' || t.TagName || '>', ps.Tags) > 0
),
tag_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        TagName,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(WeightedStarRating) AS REAL) / SUM(ViewCount), 2) AS AvgWeightedStarRating
    FROM tagged_posts
    GROUP BY TagName
),
ranked_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        TagName,
        PostId,
        Title,
        WeightedStarRating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TagName ORDER BY WeightedStarRating DESC, PostId ASC) AS rn
    FROM tagged_posts
),
top_posts_json AS (
    SELECT 
        TagName,
        json_group_array(
            json_object(
                'Id', PostId,
                'Title', Title,
                'WeightedStarRating', WeightedStarRating
            )
        ) AS TopPosts
    FROM (
        SELECT TagName, PostId, Title, WeightedStarRating
        FROM ranked_posts
        WHERE rn <= 3
    )
    GROUP BY TagName
)
SELECT 
    ta.TagName,
    ta.AvgWeightedStarRating,
    tp.TopPosts
FROM tag_avg ta
JOIN top_posts_json tp ON ta.TagName = tp.TagName
ORDER BY ta.AvgWeightedStarRating DESC

WITH post_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id AS PostId,
        p.Title,
        p.Score,
        p.ViewCount,
        CASE
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN 1
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 20 AND 39 THEN 2
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END AS StarRating,
        (CASE
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN 1
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 20 AND 39 THEN 2
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3
            WHEN p.Score BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END) * COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) AS WeightedStar
    FROM posts p
),
tagged_posts AS (
    SELECT
        t.TagName,
        ps.PostId,
        ps.Title,
        ps.ViewCount,
        ps.StarRating,
        ps.WeightedStar
    FROM post_stats ps
    JOIN tags t ON ps.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
),
tag_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        TagName,
        ROUND(SUM(WeightedStar) * 1.0 / SUM(ViewCount), 2) AS WeightedAvgStarRating
    FROM tagged_posts
    GROUP BY TagName
),
top_posts AS (
    SELECT
        TagName,
        PostId,
        Title,
        WeightedStar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TagName ORDER BY WeightedStar DESC) AS rn
    FROM tagged_posts
)
SELECT
    ta.TagName,
    ta.WeightedAvgStarRating,
    json_group_array(
        json_object(
            'Id', tp.PostId,
            'Title', tp.Title,
            'WeightedStarRating', tp.WeightedStar
        )
    ) AS TopPosts
FROM tag_aggregates ta
JOIN top_posts tp ON ta.TagName = tp.TagName
WHERE tp.rn <= 3
GROUP BY ta.TagName, ta.WeightedAvgStarRating
ORDER BY ta.WeightedAvgStarRating DESC;

The `tags` table only stores the total `Count` of posts using a tag. It does not store retention data (how long tags remain active or relevant). The SQL query constructs an arbitrary threshold formula involving the total count of tags and the maximum count, which does not represent a "retention threshold."

4.  **Engagement Metric Logic:** The question specifies engagement measured by "**vote-to-view ratios**." The SQL query compares `p.Score` directly to the calculated average ratio multiplied by 1000 (`p.Score > (SELECT avg_ratio FROM avg_vote_ratio) * 1000`). ),

    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM post_quarter_ratio
),
post_min_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.PostId,
        MIN(pq.ratio) AS min_ratio
    FROM post_quarter_ratio pq
    GROUP BY pq.PostId
    HAVING MIN(pq.ratio) > (SELECT avg_ratio FROM overall_avg_ratio)
),
expert_accepted AS (

),
tag_median AS (

)

WITH daily_rep AS (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId AS UserId,
           DATE(v.CreationDate) AS day,
           SUM(10) AS points

    JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE v.VoteTypeId IN (2, 3)  -- up‑vote types that give reputation
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId, DATE(v.CreationDate)
    HAVING SUM(10) >= 200
), cap_days AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           COUNT(*) AS days_at_cap
    FROM daily_rep
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
)

       u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN cap_days cd ON u.Id = cd.UserId;

        SUM(CASE v.VoteTypeId
            WHEN 1 THEN 5
            WHEN 2 THEN 10
            WHEN 3 THEN 15
            ELSE 0
        END) AS DailyRep

    INNER JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId, DATE(v.CreationDate)
    HAVING SUM(CASE v.VoteTypeId
        WHEN 1 THEN 5
        WHEN 2 THEN 10
        WHEN 3 THEN 15
        ELSE 0
    END) >= 200
) AS daily_rep ON u.Id = daily_rep.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30

         date(v."CreationDate") AS day,
         COUNT(*) AS votes_cnt

  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
SELECT u."Id" AS user_id,
       u."DisplayName" AS display_name
FROM "users" u
JOIN daily_cap dc ON u."Id" = dc."UserId"
GROUP BY u."Id", u."DisplayName"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30;

votes.sql:
SELECT u.DisplayName,
       u.Reputation,
       COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation >= 1000
  AND u.CreationDate <= DATE('now', '-2 years')
GROUP BY u.Id
ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC;
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Reputation, COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId GROUP BY u.Id ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC LIMIT 50

       u.Reputation,
       COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_count,

           WHEN u.Reputation >= 100000 THEN 'Epic'
           WHEN u.Reputation >= 50000 THEN 'Gold'

FROM users u
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id
ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC

WITH gold AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName
    FROM users
    WHERE Reputation >= 10000
),
badge_ok AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    WHERE Date >= date('now','-12 months')
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Name) >= 3
),
user_avg AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId AS UserId,
           AVG(ViewCount) AS avg_view
    FROM posts
    WHERE ViewCount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           avg_view,
           ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY avg_view DESC) AS decile
    FROM user_avg
)
SELECT g.DisplayName
FROM gold g
JOIN badge_ok b ON g.Id = b.UserId
JOIN ranked r ON g.Id = r.UserId
WHERE r.decile = 1;

WITH gold_qualified_users AS (
    SELECT b.UserId
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.Name LIKE '%Gold%'
      AND b.Date >= datetime('now', '-12 months')
    GROUP BY b.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.Name) >= 3
),
user_avg_views AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId AS UserId, AVG(ViewCount) AS avg_views
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL AND ViewCount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
),
gold_users_with_views AS (
    SELECT gq.UserId, uav.avg_views
    FROM gold_qualified_users gq
    INNER JOIN user_avg_views uav ON gq.UserId = uav.UserId
),
ranked_users AS (
    SELECT guv.UserId,
           guv.avg_views,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_users_with_views gw 
            WHERE gw.avg_views >= guv.avg_views) AS rank,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_users_with_views) AS total_count
    FROM gold_users_with_views guv
)
SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM ranked_users r
opy
INNER JOIN users u ON r.UserId = u.Id
WHERE r.rank <= CAST(r.total_count * 0.1 AS INTEGER) + 1;

WITH gold_users AS (
  SELECT "UserId"
  FROM badges
  WHERE "Name" = 'Gold'
),
recent_badges AS (
  SELECT "UserId"
  FROM badges
  WHERE "Date" >= datetime((SELECT MAX("Date") FROM badges), '-12 months')
  GROUP BY "UserId"
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Name") >= 3
),
user_avg_view AS (
  SELECT p."OwnerUserId" AS "UserId", AVG(p."ViewCount") AS "avg_view"
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p."ViewCount" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."OwnerUserId"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT u."Id", uav."avg_view",
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS "total_users",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY uav."avg_view" DESC) AS "rn"
  FROM users u
  JOIN user_avg_view uav ON u.Id = uav."UserId"
)
SELECT r."Id"
FROM ranked r
JOIN gold_users g ON r."Id" = g."UserId"
JOIN recent_badges rb ON r."Id" = rb."UserId"
WHERE r."rn" <= r."total_users" * 0.10;

WITH eng AS (
  SELECT Id,
    COALESCE(Score,0) + COALESCE(ViewCount,0) + COALESCE(FavoriteCount,0) + COALESCE(CommentCount,0) AS engagement
  FROM posts

tiered AS (
  SELECT engagement,
    CASE
      WHEN NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY engagement DESC) = 1 THEN 'Platinum'
      WHEN NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY engagement DESC) = 2 THEN 'Gold'
      ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS tier
  FROM eng
)

FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY CASE tier
  WHEN 'Platinum' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Gold' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Silver' THEN 3
